title: Unused gleam/option import in draft integration test
detail: The module is imported but never referenced — grep of the 572-line file finds no `option.`, `Option`, `Some`, or `None` usage. Dead import; adds compiler-warning noise to an otherwise clean suite.

title: Local list_length helper re-implements gleam/list.length
detail: Hand-rolled, non-tail-recursive duplicate of the stdlib. The same PR's draft_handler_test.gleam (line 8) and the existing awaiting_integration_test.gleam both `import gleam/list` and call `list.length` — this file is inconsistent with the codebase pattern.
recommended_fix: Add `import gleam/list`, replace the six `list_length` call sites with `list.length`, and delete the helper.
